keywords = [
]
abilities = [
    # [0]
    TriggeredAbility(
        event=LifeGainedEvent(actor=FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.CONTROLLER_IS, who=ControllerRef.YOU)),
        condition=None,
        effect=A(Verb.PUT_COUNTER, {
            'count': QConst(value=1),
            'counter_kind': CounterKind.PLUS_1_PLUS_1,
            'target': Selector(
                count=QConst(value=1),
                mode=SelectorMode.CHOOSE,
                filter=FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.IS_SOURCE),
                zones=(Zone(kind=ZoneKind.BATTLEFIELD, controller=ControllerRef.ANY),),
            ),
        }),
    ),
    # [1]
    TriggeredAbility(
        event=CreatureDiesEvent(filter=FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.IS_SOURCE)),
        condition=None,
        effect=A(Verb.MOVE_ZONE, {
            'cards': Selector(
                count=QConst(value=1),
                mode=SelectorMode.TARGET,
                filter=FAnd(
                    children=(
                        FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.TYPE_EQ, string_value='Creature'),
                        FNot(inner=FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.IS_SOURCE)),
                        FNot(inner=FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.SUBTYPE_EQ, string_value='Bear')),
                        FNot(
                            inner=FAtom(
                                pred=FAtomPred.QTY_GE,
                                count=QBin(
                                    op=QBinOp.ADD,
                                    left=QProp(referent='source', field=QPropField.POWER),
                                    right=QConst(value=1),
                                ),
                                field=QPropField.MANA_VALUE,
                            ),
                        ),
                    ),
                ),
                zones=(Zone(kind=ZoneKind.GRAVEYARD, controller=ControllerRef.YOU),),
            ),
            'destination': Zone(kind=ZoneKind.BATTLEFIELD, controller=ControllerRef.ANY),
        }),
    ),
    # [2]
    SpellAbility(kind=SpellKind.CREATURE),
]

clauses.clause: Whenever you gain life, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature.
When this creature dies, return another target non-Bear creature card with mana value less than or equal to this creature's power from your graveyard to the battlefield.
clauses.ir: abilities[1] (CreatureDiesEvent IS_SOURCE; MOVE_ZONE TARGET another non-Bear creature card from your graveyard with negated comparison of MANA_VALUE (at_most) this creature's last-known power, to the battlefield)

mapping.notes: Cavalier of Night's verified dies trigger with the target narrowed: another (FNot(IS_SOURCE)), non-Bear creature card (FNot(SUBTYPE_EQ Bear)), negated comparison of MANA_VALUE (at_most) QProp('source', POWER): the Panda's power as it last existed on the battlefield (CR 608.2h, quantity.last_known for the ability's source), +1/+1 counters included. The lifegain counter trigger is the compiler's, kept. Packs: tools/scenarios/mapped/FDN/fiendish_panda_offers_no_bear_no_six_not_itself.json, tools/scenarios/mapped/FDN/fiendish_panda_reads_its_last_power_counters_included.json.
